simpleDetails.whatIsIt: This template records vaccination against Tetanus. Horses can have different exposure risks depending on travel, competition, boarding, mosquito exposure, breeding, and contact with other horses.
simpleDetails.whyGiven: It may be included in a veterinarian-led preventive-care plan to reduce disease risk or impact when vaccination is appropriate. The correct product, eligibility, timing, and follow-up should always be confirmed with a veterinarian and local guidance.
benefits: Protects against a potentially fatal disease.
